# Loop over input items and add a new field called 'myNewField' to the JSON of each one

from langdetect import detect

# Example 1: English text
text_english = "This is an English sentence."
detected_language_english = detect(text_english)
print(f"'{text_english}' is detected as: {detected_language_english}")

# Example 2: Non-English text
text_french = "Ceci est une phrase en français."
detected_language_french = detect(text_french)
print(f"'{text_french}' is detected as: {detected_language_french}")

# Example 3: Mixed text (langdetect prioritizes the dominant language)
text_mixed = "Hello, comment ça va?"
detected_language_mixed = detect(text_mixed)
print(f"'{text_mixed}' is detected as: {detected_language_mixed}")
